goal.objective:
Gather: make the complete event-planning job work for volunteer coordinators and helpers who don't know our history.
Outcome: coordinator enters date, needs, commitments; gets useful proposed tasks, edits them naturally, sees consequences, assigns work in a private test environment, returns later to correct current state. Helpers find their work and report changes without learning our planning model. Exercise creation, revision, assignment, return, recovery as one job in a private preview with real persisted state. A static demo or happy path isn't the outcome.

Quality: appealing, coherent, easy on phone and desktop; work and next action prominent; little reading. History available, not dominant. Never drop qualifications or negatives when shortening. Test rendered UI with full event, long explanations, many assignments, sparse new event; cover empty, waiting, error, retry, undo, return. Fix visual/comprehension weaknesses; if local repairs fail, rethink the shared mechanism. Ask only on consequential direction, authority or risk.

Review: fresh independent reviewer against objective.md on the rendered complete journey with realistic content. Repair material findings, re-exercise; keep evidence gaps visible.

Authority: reversible changes, local tests, isolated data, private preview, approved services as currently authorized. No new integrations, publishing, contacting volunteers, invitations, live-event changes, purchases, irreversible actions. Isolated test accounts, read back writes, keep restore path. Protect private data, access, money.

Budget: 750 NOK total new model/API charges incl. delegates, retries; reserve for verification; unknown cost isn't free; no subscriptions. At cap stop paid work, continue free work, don't claim finished.

Real value needs coordinators over several events: prepare evaluation; never fabricate participation or time. Name exact external dependencies.
Keep handoff: progress, failures, budget left, next action.
